en: Colorized vintage view of a large European town square surrounded by historic multi‑story buildings with red and brown tiled roofs. In the middle of the square stands a monumental fountain or statue with multiple figures and steps, around which people stroll and small market stalls and café umbrellas are set up. In the background, on a wooded hill, a prominent clock tower rises above old fortification walls. The caption at the top left reads "Graz. Hauptplatz."
